quick_fix_patterns.timeout: Increase test timeout or check for async leaks. The operation may be waiting on a network call that never resolves.
quick_fix_patterns.network: Check Supabase local instance is running (supabase status). Verify SUPABASE_URL environment variable.
quick_fix_patterns.render: Component may have missing providers or context. Check that test wraps component in required providers.
quick_fix_patterns.navigation: Ensure expo-router mock is properly configured. Check that navigation state is initialized in test setup.
quick_fix_patterns.permission: Check RLS policies on the Supabase table. Verify the test user has the correct role/permissions.
quick_fix_patterns.mock: A mock may be stale or incorrectly configured. Verify mock return values match the current API contract.
quick_fix_patterns.snapshot: Run with --updateSnapshot to regenerate. Review the diff to ensure changes are intentional.
quick_fix_patterns.import: Check for circular imports or missing module resolution. Verify path aliases in jest.config.js.
quick_fix_patterns.act: Wrap state updates in act(). This usually means an async operation completed after the test ended.
quick_fix_patterns.element: Element not found in the DOM. Check testID, text content, or role used in the query. The component may not have rendered yet.
quick_fix_patterns.maestro: Flow step failed. Check if the app state matches expectations. The screen transition may need a longer wait.
quick_fix_patterns.assertion: Expected value does not match actual. Verify test data setup and check if the API response format changed.
